title: Sayben
tagline: Sayben is the identity, safety, and interaction-graph layer for autonomous agents
description: Sayben is the identity, safety, and interaction-graph layer for autonomous agents — every agent gets a MetaMask-rooted on-chain soul with capability-bounded behavior, every interaction is anchored on-chain into a public graph, and that graph doubles as an open RL dataset for training the next generation of safer agents.
how_its_made: Sayben is the identity, safety, and interaction-graph layer for autonomous agents — every agent gets a MetaMask-rooted on-chain soul with capability-bounded behavior, every interaction is anchored on-chain into a public graph, and that graph doubles as an open RL dataset for training the next generation of safer agents.
